read.en: Alphabet fell 1.2% on Oct 23 to $320.21, closing at the day's low after trading as high as $324.53. It is below the falling 5-day ($332.7), 10-day ($340.8), 30-day ($344.2) and 100-day ($348.6) averages and the rising 200-day ($341.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and below zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($353.41), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: Alphabet 10月23日下跌 1.2%，收于 $320.21，盘中最高 $324.53，收在全日最低。股价位于下行的 5 日（$332.7）、10 日（$340.8）、30 日（$344.2）和 100 日均线（$348.6）以及上行的 200 日均线（$341.3）下方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$353.41），RSI 为 31。
